entries.en: square, four-cornered (cuadrado — used as in 'the world is square').

entries.zh: 髋骨，腰骨；脚川骨（髋胯部之骨）
头阵；军中第一阵，前锋阵
entries.en: the first squadron or front rank of an army; vanguard.

entries.zh: 牌；面牌（带图像之牌位或画像牌，如圣像牌）
entries.en: a tablet or panel bearing an image; framed picture (cuadro de imagen).

entries.zh: 凝结；凝作一块（如血之凝结成块）
entries.en: to congeal, curdle (like blood); to set into one lump.
